description: Estaciones depuradoras de aguas residuales is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by aca-web.gencat.cat. Wastewater treatment plant: Installation intended to reduce the pollutant load that exists in wastewater before it is discharged to the receiving environment. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Catalunya. The listing shows 2015-11-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
